business_summary: MIRARTH Real Estate Investment Corporation is formerly known as Takara Leben Real Estate Investment Corporation. With MIRARTH Real Estate Investment Advisory Co., Ltd. (formerly Takara PAG Real Estate Investment Advisory Co. Ltd. hereinafter referred to as the Asset Management Company) as the organizer, in accordance with the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, including subsequent amendments; hereinafter referred to as the Investment Trust Act). Registration with the Kanto Regional Financial Bureau was completed (Registration No. Kanto Regional Financial Bureau Director-General No. 129). After that, on July 27, 2018, the company was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (hereinafter referred to as the Tokyo Stock Exchange) Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market. After six public offerings, the total number of investment units issued as of the end of the fiscal period under review (February 28, 2025) is 910,820 units, and the total investment amount is 87,255 million yen. MIRARTH Real Estate Investment Corporation was incorporated in 2017 in Japan.
business_summary_ko: MIRARTH 부동산 투자 회사는 이전에 Takara Leben 부동산 투자 회사로 알려져 있었습니다. 투자신탁 및 투자회사에 관한 법률(1951년 법률 제198호 및 후속 개정 포함, 이하 투자신탁법)에 따라 미라스부동산투자자문주식회사(구 타카라PAG부동산투자자문주식회사, 이하 자산운용회사)를 주관사로 합니다. 간토 재정국에 등록이 완료되었습니다(등록번호 간토 재정국장 제129호). 이후 2018년 7월 27일에 당사는 도쿄증권거래소(이하 도쿄증권거래소) 부동산투자신탁증권시장에 상장되었습니다. 6차례 공모를 거쳐 검토 대상 회계연도 말(2025년 2월 28일) 현재 발행된 총 투자 단위 수는 910,820 단위, 총 투자 금액은 87,255백만엔이다. 미라스부동산투자공사는 2017년 일본에서 법인을 설립하였습니다.
